body_html:
Stephanie M brings vibrant energy, personality, and a deep love of electronic music to every event she performs. Originally from Westchester, New York, Stephanie has always thrived in social environments where people gather to celebrate, laugh, and connect. Her natural charisma and passion for entertainment make her a dynamic presence both behind the DJ booth and on the microphone.

Stephanie’s journey into DJing began the first time she heard “Heaven” by DJ Sammy. The song sparked a curiosity that quickly turned into a passion for understanding how electronic music is created and mixed. From that moment on, she knew she wanted to craft her own mixes and bring that same feeling of excitement to audiences everywhere.

While she is newer to formal hosting, Stephanie has built a strong foundation through her work in streaming, music production, and gaming communities. She frequently attends open mic nights for both comedy and music, experiences that have sharpened her stage presence and confidence with live audiences. Her background as a content creator also keeps her closely connected to modern music culture and online communities.

When it comes to music, Stephanie’s headphones are filled with high-energy and eclectic sounds. Her favorites include bubblegum pop, hyperpop, eurodance, J-pop, K-pop, house, bedroom pop, indie, and anything reminiscent of the iconic Dance Dance Revolution era. Electronic music is at the heart of her sound, and she loves building sets that keep the dance floor moving.

For Stephanie, the best part of DJing is watching people connect through music. Seeing a room full of guests come together, dance, and share in the moment is what fuels her passion behind the decks.

She especially enjoys performing at high-energy events such as anime raves, drag shows, and LGBTQ+ community gatherings where the atmosphere is vibrant and expressive. Her go-to floor fillers include crowd favorites like “Barbie Girl” by Aqua, “We Like to Party” by Vengaboys, and “Gypsy Woman” by Crystal Waters—songs that instantly bring smiles and get people moving.

Outside of DJing, Stephanie is a content creator focused on anime, video games, and internet culture. She produces short-form content across platforms like TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram, and spends time drawing, writing music, streaming, and creating online content for fans with similar interests. She’s also musically talented, playing multiple instruments, singing, and even flawlessly rapping the rapid-fire verses of “Look at Me Now” featuring Busta Rhymes and Lil Wayne.

At home, Stephanie shares her space with her two cats, Ada Wong and Ashley Graham, named after iconic characters from the Resident Evil video game series.

Known for her playful personality and sense of humor, Stephanie describes herself as a “silly, outgoing, and passionate” entertainer who truly loves connecting with people through music. Whether she’s DJing a party, hosting trivia, or bringing energy to a themed event, she thrives on tailoring the experience to the audience. She is also a strong supporter of the LGBTQ+ community and enjoys performing at inclusive venues and events.

And if you ever meet her at an event, you might even hear the unbelievable story about the time she fell down a sewer hole during a class trip and somehow walked away with nothing but a scratch.

With her enthusiasm, creativity, and dedication to delivering unforgettable experiences, DJ Stephanie M is ready to bring energy, personality, and great music to any event.
